scenario_title: Backend Developer - API quản lý đơn hàng
context: Một nền tảng thương mại điện tử cần API để tạo, cập nhật và theo dõi đơn hàng an toàn.

requirements.text: Authenticated customers must create an order with validated items, delivery address and payment method.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask how a customer creates an order.

requirements.text: The API must validate stock and reserve inventory before confirming an order.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask what happens when stock changes during checkout.

requirements.text: Create-order requests must support idempotency to prevent duplicate orders after client retries.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask how the API handles network retries.

requirements.text: Only authorized users can view or update their own orders, while staff permissions are role based.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask who can access an order.
requirements.condition: by customer ownership and staff role

requirements.text: The API must return consistent error codes for validation, stock conflict, payment failure and unauthorized access.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask how API errors are returned to clients.

requirements.text: Order state changes must be audited and the read API should meet the agreed latency target.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask about non-functional requirements and traceability.
